profile.name: 中央控制器（CC）
profile.description: 一种用于超导量子比特实验的数字时序与序列控制设备，可加载并运行实验序列，协调 CCIO 模块与数字 I/O 链路，并支持状态监测、DIO 校准和时序延迟调整，常用于量子测控系统中的脉冲时序控制与实验同步。
profile.description_en: A digital timing and sequence control instrument for superconducting qubit experiments. It loads and runs experiment sequences, coordinates CCIO modules and digital I/O links, and supports status monitoring, DIO calibration, and timing delay adjustment for pulse sequencing and experiment synchronization in quantum control setups.
